comparator.name: International Business
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme page and 2026-2027 Ocasys curriculum define a fixed 60-EC first year and fixed 60-EC second year. Year 3 contains one genuine 30-EC choice among study abroad, an International Business internship or an approved faculty minor, followed by 30 EC of compulsory international strategy, research design and analytics, international financial management, international business organisations and a 10-EC bachelor's thesis. The open 30-EC choice is preserved generically rather than filled for UCR fit. The coherent pathway totals exactly 180 EC.
components: Study abroad, International Business internship or approved faculty minor
One 30-EC option is required. The approved open choice is preserved without inventing a student selection.
Research Design and Data Analytics for IB

alternatives.label: International business, management & entrepreneurship
alternatives.concept: A broad closest feasible international-business programme combining global strategy, entrepreneurship, marketing, leadership, organisational behaviour and governance with accounting, finance, economics, research, data, sustainability and business law.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines international business and management with entrepreneurship, economics, finance, marketing, data, law and leadership; the label accurately states its broad business composition.
progression: Business, economics, data and research foundations precede advanced strategy, law, leadership, econometrics and market research. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.
traceOverrides: examines managerial and organisational implications of AI and technological change within a broad international-business curriculum
introduces machine-learning models for evidence-based analysis within the programme's data and technology strand
develops microeconomic and behavioural analysis of consumer and firm decisions

alternatives.label: Business, AI & digital transformation
alternatives.concept: An international-business direction organised around innovation, analytics, artificial intelligence and digital transformation, combining programming, machine learning and deep learning with strategy, organisations, marketing, finance and responsible technology.
alternatives.labelReason: The curriculum retains a substantial business core while adding a sequenced programming, mathematics, data, algorithms and AI strand, so the label names both business and AI.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the broad closest match, this route replaces much of the general economics, communication and leadership mix with programming, mathematics, algorithms, databases, machine learning, deep learning and AI ethics. The resulting educational choice is a technology-intensive international-business curriculum, not a cosmetic relabelling.
progression: Business, programming, data, research and mathematical foundations precede advanced strategy, algorithms, machine learning, deep learning, international business and market research. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra, probability and deep learning; programming precedes algorithms. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Finance, trade & global business
alternatives.concept: An international-business direction centred on accounting, finance, trade, political economy and analytical decision-making, combining banking, economics and econometrics with probability, data science, programming and global governance.
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is organised around finance and accounting but also contains trade, economics, quantitative analysis, strategy and international governance, so the label includes global business.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest match and the AI route, this curriculum gives greater weight to finance, banking, accounting, economics, econometrics, probability, trade and behavioural decision-making while retaining an international-business foundation.
progression: Business, economics, programming, data, research and mathematical foundations precede public economics, international business, probability, machine learning, econometrics, behavioural economics and finance. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra and probability; Business Foundations precedes Money, Banking & Finance and International Business & Governance. All formal prerequisites occur earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

selection.assessment: The broad closest match owns the general international-management, strategy, markets, culture, sustainability, responsibility, supply-chain, marketing and ethics interests. Two generator-backed directions remain coherent and feasible: innovation with digital transformation and analytics, and international finance with trade and political economy. Their completed curricula are substantively different and pairwise exceed the 30-EC floor, so the maximum of three alternatives is reached.

notes.text: Groningen's International Business curriculum supplies a dense compulsory sequence in supply chains, accounting, multinational location, cross-cultural management, qualitative methods, international finance and a required thesis. UCR can build coherent international-business, digital-transformation and finance programmes, but it does not reproduce that complete specialist sequence or the compulsory thesis.
